products.title: 3-Piece Baby Feeding Bowl Set - PP Microwave-Safe 60ML Sealed Storage
products.body_html:
3-Piece Baby Feeding Bowl Set with Sealed Storage

The 3-Piece Baby Feeding Bowl Set provides practical feeding solutions for babies aged 7-12 months. This portable set includes microwave-safe bowls with sealed storage boxes, designed for complementary food introduction and everyday use.

Safe PP Material Construction

Crafted from PVC-free PP material, these feeding bowls meet safety standards for baby products. The durable construction withstands daily use, microwave heating, and regular cleaning. The patchwork pattern adds visual interest during feeding time.

60ML Capacity Square Design

Each bowl holds 60ML of food, suitable for serving purees, cereals, and complementary foods. The square shape provides stability on flat surfaces, reducing spills during self-feeding practice. The compact size fits easily in diaper bags for on-the-go feeding.

Microwave-Safe with Sealed Storage

Heat prepared meals directly in these microwave-safe bowls without transferring food between containers. The sealed storage boxes keep pre-prepared meals fresh in the refrigerator, simplifying meal prep routines. Lids prevent spills during transport and maintain food freshness.

Portable Feeding Solution

The lightweight design makes this set practical for travel, daycare, and visits to family. The three-piece configuration provides multiple bowls for different foods or meal prep throughout the day. Suitable for babies transitioning to solid foods between 7-12 months of age.

Product Specifications

  • Material: PVC-free PP
  • Capacity: 60ML per bowl
  • Shape: Square
  • Quantity: 3 pieces
  • Age Range: 7-12 months
  • Features: Microwave-safe, sealed storage, portable
  • Pattern: Patchwork

Perfect for playdates and family gatherings where your toddler can dine alongside others. The set also serves well during snack time for fruits, yogurt, and small bites. Makes a practical gift for baby showers or first birthday celebrations.

Specifically sized for toddlers aged 1-2 years, each utensil promotes independence and proper grip development. The spoon and fork dimensions accommodate small hands learning to self-feed, while the bowl's 20cm diameter provides ample space for portion-appropriate meals. The cartoon bear motif captures attention and creates positive mealtime associations.

Baby Silicone Bowl Newborn Tableware Set

The Levvii Baby Silicone Bowl Newborn Tableware Set delivers a complete feeding solution for infants and toddlers transitioning to solid foods. Inspire your child’s early development and transform playtime into a rewarding learning journey with the Chickamic Matching Eggs Set. This interactive Montessori tool is designed to sharpen color recognition, master geometric shapes, and strengthen fine motor skills through hands-on discovery. Perfect for independent play, classroom activities, or as a vibrant addition to an Easter basket, it makes early education both fun and effortless.

Featuring child-safe materials, a variety of colorful interiors, and a sturdy storage case, the Chickamic Matching Eggs bring quality and convenience to your toddler's daily play routine.

• Montessori Learning: Designed to promote cognitive growth and logical thinking through self-correcting shape-sorting play.

• Geometric Shape Mastery: Each egg interior features a unique embossed shape, encouraging spatial awareness and problem-solving.

• Durable & Child-Safe: Made from high-quality, BPA-free ABS plastic with smooth edges to ensure safe handling for little fingers.

Cleaning: Simply wipe the plastic eggs with a damp cloth or rinse under warm water with mild soap after play sessions to keep them hygienic.

Why Choose CuddleBee Cotton Saliva Towel?

This cotton bib combines functionality with comfort. The breathable cotton material allows air circulation, preventing heat buildup around your baby's neck area. Its absorbent properties handle heavy drooling during teething phases and catch spills during feeding sessions.

The lightweight construction means your baby won't feel weighed down, while the durable fabric withstands repeated washing without losing softness or absorbency. Machine washable and quick-drying, these bibs are ready for use when you need them most.

Perfect for Daily Use

Whether at home during feeding time, out for errands, or visiting family, the CuddleBee Baby Cotton Saliva Towel provides reliable protection. The gentle cotton fabric prevents chafing and irritation, making it suitable for extended wear throughout the day.

Keep your little one clean, happy, and comfortable with the CuddleBee Baby Cotton Saliva Towel.

The GoofyCub Silicone Baby Plate transforms mealtime into a stress-free experience for parents and toddlers. This non-slip feeding bowl features a secure base that keeps food in place, minimizing spills and allowing your child to focus on developing self-feeding skills.

Safe Silicone Material: Made from 100% food-grade silicone that's BPA-free, phthalate-free, and safe for children of all ages.

Easy to Clean: Dishwasher-safe construction resists stains and odors. The smooth surface wipes clean effortlessly after every meal.

Lightweight & Portable: Compact design fits easily in diaper bags, making it ideal for daycare, restaurants, travel, and visits to grandparents' homes.

Encourages Self-Feeding: The divided sections and stable base support your child's developmental milestones, building confidence and independence during mealtimes.

Why Choose the GoofyCub Silicone Baby Plate?

This silicone feeding bowl adapts to your family's lifestyle. Whether you're introducing first foods, managing the transition to solid foods, or looking for reliable tableware for your growing toddler, the GoofyCub plate delivers consistent performance. The durable silicone withstands temperature variations, making it suitable for warm and cold foods alike.

Parents appreciate the practical design that reduces mealtime battles and cleanup efforts. The non-slip feature means less food on the floor and more successful self-feeding attempts. The soft material is gentle on developing gums and safe if your child decides to chew on the edges.

Suitable for home use, daycare settings, restaurant outings, and travel, this versatile baby plate becomes an essential part of your feeding routine. The GoofyCub Silicone Baby Plate combines safety, functionality, and convenience in one thoughtfully designed product.

The LittleSprout Silicone Baby Bottle Brush Set provides everything needed to keep baby bottles, nipples, and feeding accessories thoroughly clean and hygienically stored. BPA-Free Silicone Construction

Crafted from BPA-free, durable silicone, these brushes are safe for all baby feeding items. The silicone bristles effectively remove milk residue and bacteria without scratching delicate bottle surfaces or nipples. Unlike traditional brushes that can harbor bacteria in their bristles, silicone dries quickly and resists bacterial growth.

The set includes a full-size bottle brush for cleaning bottles of various sizes, a specialized nipple cleaner designed to reach into small crevices, a drying rack to hold multiple items, and a stable base that keeps everything organized on your countertop. Hygienic Drying and Storage

The included drying rack and base create a dedicated space for air-drying all cleaning tools and baby bottles. This keeps brushes elevated and separated, allowing proper airflow to prevent moisture buildup and maintain hygiene between uses. The compact design fits easily on kitchen counters without taking up excessive space.

Suitable for Home and Travel

The complete set is practical for daily home use and convenient enough to pack for travel. Whether setting up a feeding station at grandparents' homes or preparing for extended stays away from home, this brush set ensures consistent cleaning standards wherever you go.

products.body_html:
The constant struggle of introducing a baby to solid foods can be a source of daily stress and frustration. Without a spoon explicitly designed for a baby's sensitive gums and small mouth, a person may face a constant cycle of gagging, messes, and a baby's refusal to eat. The constant struggle with these issues can result in fatigue, a lack of confidence in baby-led weaning, and a feeling of being unprepared, highlighting the critical need for an effective and reliable solution like a dedicated Baby Silicone Rice Paste Feeding Spoon. 


A proper Baby Silicone Rice Paste Feeding Spoon features a soft, flexible tip, a secure grip, and a seamless, easy-to-clean design for optimal convenience and safety. These items are designed to make the transition to solids easier, reduce messes, and ensure a baby is comfortably and safely fed. This proactive approach to mealtime ensures a smoother, more enjoyable family experience.


 



REASONS WHY A SILICONE FEEDING SPOON WILL CHANGE A BABY'S EXPERIENCE


✅ GENTLE ON SENSITIVE GUMS: A Baby Silicone Rice Paste Feeding Spoon is crafted from ultra-soft silicone that is gentle on a baby's delicate gums and new teeth. This feature makes it indispensable for preventing irritation and discomfort during feeding.

✅ PERFECT FOR FIRST FOODS: The shallow, flexible tip is designed to hold just the right amount of rice paste or pureed food, making it easy for a baby to accept and swallow. This design helps a parent confidently introduce a variety of first foods.




✅ EASY-TO-CLEAN & HYGIENIC: Silicone is a non-porous material resistant to bacteria and easy to clean. These spoons are designed with no seams or grooves where food can get stuck, making cleanup simple with soap and water or in the dishwasher.

✅ SAFE & CHILD-FRIENDLY MATERIALS: Crafted from high-quality, food-grade silicone, these spoons are free from BPA, PVC, and other harmful chemicals. The soft and flexible material is safe for a baby to bite and chew on.




✅ ERGONOMIC DESIGN FOR PARENT'S HAND: The spoon's handle is shaped to fit comfortably in a person's hand, providing a secure grip and control during feeding. This reduces hand fatigue and ensures a stable, stress-free feeding session.

The CradleLuxe Silicone Baby Bib provides reliable protection during mealtime with food-grade, BPA-free silicone construction. This waterproof feeding bib shields clothing from spills, dribbles, and stains while remaining gentle on sensitive skin.

The soft, flexible material moves naturally with your baby, ensuring comfort throughout feeding sessions. A deep catch pocket collects falling food and liquids, significantly reducing cleanup time. Adjustable straps accommodate infants and toddlers of various sizes, providing a secure fit that stays in place. The lightweight, durable design makes this bib suitable for home use, daycare environments, or travel.

Product Features

  • Waterproof Design: Protects clothing from spills and dribbles.
  • Deep Food Pocket: Catches falling food to minimize mess.
  • Adjustable & Comfortable: Fits infants and toddlers securely.
  • Easy to Clean: Dishwasher safe or rinse with water for quick cleaning.

Why Choose Food-Grade Silicone?

Food-grade silicone offers distinct advantages for baby feeding products. The material resists staining and odor absorption, maintaining hygiene across repeated uses. Unlike fabric bibs that require washing and drying, silicone bibs clean instantly with a quick rinse or dishwasher cycle. The waterproof barrier prevents liquids from soaking through to clothing, while the flexible texture remains comfortable against delicate skin.

Deep Pocket Design

The integrated catch pocket extends outward to collect dropped food and spilled liquids before they reach your baby's lap or the floor. This design feature proves particularly valuable during self-feeding stages when infants and toddlers are developing motor skills. The pocket capacity handles substantial amounts of food, reducing the frequency of mid-meal cleanups.

Adjustable Fit for Growing Babies

Multiple adjustment settings on the neck strap allow the bib to grow with your child from early infancy through toddler years. The secure closure prevents removal by curious hands while maintaining comfort. The flexible silicone conforms to different body shapes without creating pressure points or restricting movement.

Maintenance and Care

Cleaning requires minimal effort—place the bib on the top rack of your dishwasher or rinse under running water. The non-porous silicone surface prevents bacterial growth and wipes clean without scrubbing. The material withstands repeated washing without degrading, cracking, or losing flexibility.

The CradleLuxe Silicone Baby Bib combines practical functionality with durable construction for reliable feeding protection.
